name: KhudeBarta Order Notify
author: HR Hasib

sections.description:
KhudeBarta Order Notify is an advanced SMS integration plugin for WooCommerce.
It allows you to:

✔ Send SMS using KhudeBarta Bulk SMS API
✔ Automatically notify customers for order status updates
✔ Customize SMS templates
✔ Send test SMS from admin panel
✔ Replace placeholders like #NAME# and #ORDER_ID#
✔ Enable/Disable SMS per status
✔ Works with any WooCommerce-based store

This plugin is developed by HR Hasib (We Share IT) —
a professional IT agency specializing in Facebook marketing,
design, video ads, website development & corporate caller tune services.

Features

  • Send SMS manually from dashboard
  • WooCommerce automatic order notifications
  • Custom SMS template editor
  • Separate SMS for each order status
  • API Key, Secret Key & Caller ID support
  • Multiple numbers supported (separate by semicolon 😉
  • Lightweight, fast & secure
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to KhudeBarta SMS → Settings
  4. Enter:
    • API Key
    • Secret Key
    • Caller ID
    • Base URL (default provided)
  5. Go to “Order Notify” to customize SMS templates
sections.faq:
Which SMS Gateway does it support?

Only KhudeBarta Bulk SMS API.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I customize the SMS text?

Yes. Every status has its own editable SMS template.

Can I send SMS to multiple numbers?

Yes. Use semicolon ; to separate numbers.
